evaluation_status: Post-test exploratory; prospective execution-contract amendment, not a quality-selected recipe.

amendment.reason: The original32-query BF16 batch reproduces its stored vectors exactly, but other online group geometry does not meet the frozen cross-geometry query-parity gate.
amendment.preservation: Original cache, rejected smoke and diagnostic evidence stay immutable. No vector tolerance, item bank, encoder weight, instruction, pooling, precision or scoring-weight change.
amendment.new_contract: Quality is measured with actual raw forwards in the same immutable execution groups later used by independent raw parity/timing/profile forwards.
amendment.not_claimed: Historical batch32 cache invariance, a specific CUDA kernel cause, or validation of the rejected v1 pipeline comparison.

pipeline_query_execution.construction: Shared label-independent session/batch hash schedule measured prefix, warmup suffix, then remaining rows chunked at the same batch width. Every quality row occurs exactly once, with ordered membership and remainder handling recorded.
pipeline_query_execution.independence: Backend, scorer, candidate cap, boundary and reduced measurement budgets do not change the immutable query-group partition.
pipeline_query_execution.probes: At least100 source queries, retaining whole execution groups. The100-row smoke has its own explicit manifest and does not certify production quality.
pipeline_query_execution.quality: Real raw query forward, ANN, prefix scoring and final selection in the declared groups, scattered back to canonical panel order.
pipeline_query_execution.timing: Independent raw forwards in identical groups; no cached query substitution inside the timed operation.
pipeline_query_execution.historical_cache: Source lineage and explicitly non-qualifying drift diagnostic only.
pipeline_query_execution.reference_matching: Execution-group SHA and actual canonical-quality-query SHA must match between candidate and reference.

canonical_query_parity.scope: Independent raw forwards versus the new same-group quality reference, after FP16 canonicalization. No relaxed tolerance or bit-exact claim.

profiling.quality_population: Same fixed1097 IR cohort for both scorers; primary1000 selected dev queries and separate43/54 TREC panels.
primary_quality_contrasts: Silver rowwise INT8 minus FAISS FP32, batch16/probes64/top1000/cap50/semantic-MLP-seed17
profiling.primary_quality_aggregation: Average the paired per-query metric difference across the three fixed session/group contexts, then resample the1000 query identities once. Report each session individually; do not treat three contexts as3000 independent queries.
profiling.secondary_quality_scope: Batch1, other candidate caps, BGE and TREC panels remain separately labeled secondary comparisons; no selection among these points upgrades them to the primary two contrasts.
profiling.uncertainty: Paired query bootstrap20000 draws,seed20261011; Bonferroni97.5% two-sided percentile intervals for two primary contrasts, secondary pointwise95% exploratory intervals.
profiling.required_lower_confidence_bound: Candidate minus reference lower bound > -0.002; insufficient precision is inconclusive, not equivalence.
profiling.latency_reference: Fresh corresponding FAISS FP32 resident point under this same-group query policy and the same session/batch/scorer/prefix.
profiling.boundary_control: Cached MLP resident versus local cascade within each backend: exact candidate/final IDs, rtol=atol=1e-5 scores, and independent same-group query parity.
profiling.alternative_benefit: At least8GiB observed memory savings with at most5% slower mean complete-pipeline wall time.
profiling.reference_memory_policy: Reference-only FP32 requires at least2GiB observed headroom; it does not qualify as a deployment candidate unless it also passes8GiB.
profiling.headroom_interpretation: Finite sampled admission and stress evidence, not a continuous-peak or unseen-workload guarantee.
profiling.trace_policy: Separate CPU/CUDA profiles; never sum overlapping stage times or treat profiles as primary wall-time samples.

review_policy.numeric_context_limit: Not exposed; no unverified1M-token capacity claim.
